in_marathi.name: Luvkush
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Love and Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Luvkush हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Luvkush is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Luv' (love) and 'Kush' (prosperity). This name signifies a deep love that brings prosperity and abundance in one's life.
